instruction.text: Select the correct plural form of the singular noun before it falls down.

hint.text:
Remember to add an -s if a word ends in a vowel and a y.
key = keys

Drop the y and add -ies if the word ends in a consonant and a y
baby = babies
hint.sound: ssml: Remember to add an s if a word ends in a vowel and a why. <break time='300ms'/> Drop the y and add <break time='100ms'/>i e s if the word ends in a consonant and a why

hint.text: Remember that some plural nouns change vowels. If this is the case, -s or -es do not need to be added.
hint.sound: Remember that some plural nouns change vowels. If this is the case, -s or e s do not need to be added.

hint.text: Remember that some nouns are the same in singular and plural.
Remember to change words ending in -f or -fe to a v. To show that it is plural, add -es to the v.
hint.sound: Remember to change words ending in f or f e to a vee. To show that it is plural, add e s to the vee.

instruction.text: Look at the bolded singular irregular noun and fill in the plural form in the gap.

atoms.a: Last night, my sister looked in the mirror after losing a tooth to count how many she had left.
atoms.b: We ended up counting over twenty ((teeth)) still in her mouth.

atoms.a: Last time I went fly-fishing with my grandma, I only caught one fish.
atoms.b: This time, I ended up catching eight ((fish))!

atoms.a: Joseph stopped at the store to get a fresh loaf of bread for the barbecue party.
atoms.b: When he arrived at the party, he saw that there were already ten other ((loaves)) of bread there. Oops!
